title: Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments
abstract: arXiv:2611.30745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% [8.2-17.2%]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. translated_title: 面向工具调用型LLM智能体的意图条件化参数中介：阻断“可信但未授权”参数
translated_abstract: LLM智能体将用户的请求和检索到的内容转化为工具调用，而一次调用可能会到达错误的接收者、端点、文件或参与者。参数级别的来源追踪（provenance）方法会阻断来自不受信任内容的此类参数值，但会接受用户从未请求过的可信值。IntentFlow是一个位于未经修改的规划器与其工具之间的中介层，它根据意图契约和来源策略检查每个承载权限的参数。在一个包含200次攻击的合成基准测试上（包含预言机级别的意图与注入标签、声明的角色），攻击成功率从仅使用来源追踪时的50.5%下降到12.0% [8.2-17.2%]；且每一例残余的成功攻击都只改变了内容或载荷字段。IntentFlow在200个配对的良性任务中没有错误阻断任何一个，在50个困难任务中仅错误阻断了4个。在50次“可信但未授权”攻击中，仅使用来源追踪的中介方式执行了全部50次攻击，而IntentFlow一次都没有执行；CaMeL风格的检查同样阻断了全部50次攻击，但在50个良性任务中拒绝了16个。
tldr: IntentFlow作为规划器与工具之间的中介层，通过意图契约和来源策略双重检查承载权限的工具调用参数，将攻击成功率从50.5%降至12.0%，并能完全阻断“可信但未授权”参数攻击且几乎不误伤良性任务。
en_tdlr: IntentFlow, a mediation layer between the planner and tools, checks authority-bearing tool-call arguments against an intent contract and a provenance policy, reducing attack success from 50.5% to 12.0% and fully blocking trusted-but-unauthorized arguments while barely rejecting benign tasks.
